RQ2_CONCLUSION: Rank 1 reaches 95.4--99.6\% success and 93.0--99.2\% coverage. Higher ranks offer no monotonic benefit; bars show the two-seed range. The style branch stays fixed, so this does not establish pure-LoRA sufficiency.
RQ3_CONCLUSION: All eight pure models have exactly zero action response to private-code sign changes and zero private two-strategy coverage. TwoRoom joint success falls to 43.4\% (keep-out) and 22.5\% (waypoint). Cube keep-out retains 96.1\% ordinary goal success but 0\% joint success; waypoint retains 83.6\% joint success as default behavior. The existing branch supplies both constraint conditioning and private control. This does not isolate the scale/shift functional form from the conditioning pathway it carries.
